Class ClientSupplier

java.lang.Object
be.henallux.project.model.ClientSupplier
All Implemented Interfaces:
Model
public class ClientSupplier extends Object implements Model
This class represents a client or supplier, which can be either a client, a supplier, or both. It contains various fields such as id, name, firstname, email, phone number, address, VAT number, and the date they became a client. The class includes several validations for these fields such as regex, not null, not empty, and logical consistency between the boolean fields (isClient, isSupplier, isUs). The class provides a constructor that takes all the fields as parameters and performs the necessary validations.
